Well Empire Day is the day the Emperor declared them outlaws, so it might be worth getting that information out there as soon as possible.|An Imperial data officer speaking of an imprisoned Jedi|<ref name="SWG:HED">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Imperial|Happy Empire Day!|Talus}}</ref>}}
A '''data officer''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] rank within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Imperial Data Officer}}</ref> At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Unidentified Imperial data officer|data officer]] was  stationed at the [[Science Outpost]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />
